notes: Step 1 parts were correct; no parts added or dropped.

Piezo buzzer legs are in breadboard columns 5 and 8, row h. The left leg (column 5) is the negative leg and goes to the black GND wire. The right leg (column 8) is the positive leg and goes to the red wire on pin 8. This matches the schematic (+ to pin 8, - to GND) and the catalogue's buzzer polarity (pin 2 = +, pin 1 = -).

The breadboard naming follows the catalogue: bank 'b' is rows f-j. The image draws rows j-f in the upper half, so I used '5b' and '8b' for the strips holding the buzzer legs and wire ends. The wires sit in row g, in the same column strips as the legs.
The black wire goes to the Uno GND header pin next to AREF. I called it GND.1, since the catalogue does not say which of its GND ports that is.
No resistor is in the tutorial's circuit, so none is added. The code comment mentions an 8 ohm speaker, but the images show a piezo buzzer.
